title: Prepared polypropylene microplastics: formation of eco-corona in aquatic systems and their combined toxicity with cadmium in Artemia franciscana
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,2655-2672
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00260E, Paper
Anna Sundar Sarmila, Natarajan Chandrasekaran
Our study investigated the interactions between colloids present in various aquatic environments and the surface of microplastics (MPs), with a specific focus on their behavior in tap water, lake water and marine water systems.
